# agentswarm

> One YAML file, a swarm of expert agents, no idle panes. agentswarm is an agent-native, self-improving agent
> employee, Hive, whose job is dispatch: it reads a swarm.yaml, starts one coding agent per tmux pane, starts each
> role only when the roles it depends on are done, and tracks every role to done. Use it from any coding agent
> through its MCP server, its skills, its Claude Code plugin or its command line.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every tool and how to call it, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): install, quick start, the swarm.yaml reference
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): Hive, the agent employee: mission, personality, boundaries

## Skills

- [skills/author-swarm/SKILL.md](skills/author-swarm/SKILL.md): turn a goal into a valid swarm.yaml
- [skills/run-swarm/SKILL.md](skills/run-swarm/SKILL.md): deploy a swarm and follow it to done
- [skills/debug-swarm/SKILL.md](skills/debug-swarm/SKILL.md): find why a swarm is stuck, idle or never finishing

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): the `agentswarm-mcp` server, 3 tools: validate_swarm, swarm_status, memory_search
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the server's one-line config for any MCP client

## Plugin and sub-agents

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, MCP server, hook)
- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): the swarm-guard hook, which blocks commands that would end every swarm or steal focus
- [.claude/agents/swarm-designer.md](.claude/agents/swarm-designer.md): sub-agent that writes and validates a swarm.yaml for a goal
- [.claude/agents/swarm-doctor.md](.claude/agents/swarm-doctor.md): sub-agent that diagnoses a stuck swarm
- [gemini-extension.json](gemini-extension.json): the Gemini CLI extension
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](.well-known/agent-card.json): the A2A agent card

## How it improves itself

- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract and its honest level
- [eval/run.sh](eval/run.sh): the evals (surfaces, golden swarms with pass^3)
- [scripts/improve.mjs](scripts/improve.mjs): one turn of the nightly improvement loop
- [memory/MEMORY.md](memory/MEMORY.md): the memory index
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): every correction, kept as a rule

## Docs

- [examples/content-swarm.yaml](examples/content-swarm.yaml): a four-role content pipeline
- [examples/oss-pipeline.yaml](examples/oss-pipeline.yaml): a three-role pipeline from finding an open-source project idea to its scaffold
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute
